_about: Nightly theme Housie reel (scripts/theme/daily.js). Every night uses the NEXT storyline in `order` (never the previous night's), then the next words variant of that story, and numbers seeded by the date. The researcher routine reviews stats per story and variant (tracker reels with format 'Theme Housie', fields story + variant) and edits this file: add a fresh variant, drop a weak one, pin a winner (stories.<id>.pinned), or set pinnedStory. Placeholders: {theme}, {group}, {n}, {i}, {day}, {times}. New storylines need engine code (src/theme/engine.js + STORIES in scripts/theme/build.js).
